elevenlabsPrompt:
[exasperated] Your iPhone sees the Wi-Fi but just won't join it?

[confident] Here's the fix. Make your iPhone forget the network.

[friendly] Open Settings, then Wi-Fi. Tap the i next to the network. Tap Forget This Network, then join again.

[delighted] Type the password fresh, and it connects like new.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
